The Craft

From Sanganer, With Patience

One block. One impression. Thousands of repetitions.

Sanganeri printing was born in the printers' quarters of Sanganer, near Jaipur — a craft of carved teak blocks, madder-red and maroon dyes, and motifs drawn from the gardens of Rajasthan. Every metre of cloth at Garud's carries that lineage.

Our shirts and kurtas begin as soft cotton, are printed motif-by-motif by hand, and finished so the colours settle deep into the weave — made to be worn, washed and loved for years.

  • ✦Hand-carved blocks — every buti pressed individually, no two exactly alike.
  • ✦Heritage palette — ivory grounds with madder red & deep maroon motifs.
  • ✦Breathable cotton — cut for Jaipur summers, styled for everywhere.
